title: Ocotillo Water Reclamation Facility Expansion Completed
summary: Chandler records completion of a $122 million expansion while the reclamation plant remained in operation.
key_findings: The work expanded treatment capacity from 10 to 15 million gallons per day in the release.
The project logged 473,981 worker-hours without a lost-time accident.
why_it_matters: It adds completed and accepted infrastructure to the receiving-system comparator.
ftfn_relevance: Advances one named Phase 55Y reader journey.
Separates the current evidence stage from downstream operation or outcome claims.
Creates a specific next-record watch point.
evidence_limits: Rated capacity and completion do not establish current utilization.
The source does not disclose industrial customer flows.
